name: [🚨UPD10] Pop Bubbles!
desc:
🫧 Welcome to Pop & Collect!

How to Play:
🫧 Pop Bubbles to earn cash
🌈 Catch Bubble Pets
⚔️ Equip Bubble Pets to deal more damage
🗺️ Unlock 10+ zones
🎲 Open Lucky Blocks to get OP weapons
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect pets
🔮 Rebirth to unlock mutations
👹 Fight giant boss bubbles with friends
🛡️ Join or create a guild
✨ Discover rarer bubble pets, mutations, weapons, and pets!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
